label: V8C_EXPOSED50_STRUCTURAL_REPLAY
evidence_class_note: these 50 outcomes were opened in V8B.1; usable for support distributions, control-distinctness, endpoint reachability, aggregation debugging and real-corpus regression ONLY -- never to claim fresh Sonnet advantage, never to choose a threshold (V8C instruction 21)

pit_context.was: single global cut at index.kick[int(len(index.kick)*0.7)] -- future information for every target before that cut, including the target's own row
pit_context.now: cut = index.kick[rec_i], strictly-before, rebuilt per target fixture

pre_t.consistency_invariant: PRE_T_EVALUABLE => post-T status in {SCORE_OK, SCORE_REFUSED(observed unavailable)}

aggregate.arm_score_rule: equal-weight mean of SCORE_OK only; None when zero SCORE_OK
aggregate.pairing_rule: LISTWISE: fixture contributes only where BOTH sides are not None
aggregate.block_rule: G(n) = min(20, n // 5), no clamp up; contiguous in kickoff order

sonnet_eligibility.note: eligibility is STRUCTURAL: it reads no target observation, no effect, no score and no direction

consistency_invariant.rule: PRE_T_EVALUABLE => post-T status in {SCORE_OK, SCORE_REFUSED(observed unavailable)}

blocks.rule: G(n) = min(MAX_ENUMERATED_G, n // MIN_FIXTURES_PER_BLOCK), no clamp up
